authority: author observation of the original raw bitmap only

source.appearance: Black printed lines and italic mathematical labels on a white field; no colored regions, grid, border, caption, dimensions or scale.

objects.attachment: free arrow above the shared horizontal axis; not joined to either origin

topology: O lies left of O_1 on one straight shared horizontal support.
X is the rightward ray of K; X_1 is the rightward ray of K_1. Their positive directions agree and their support lines coincide.
The shared support visibly continues through O_1, with an intermediate X arrowhead and a farther-right X_1 arrowhead.
Y and Y_1 are distinct parallel upward vertical rays rooted at O and O_1 respectively.
Z and Z_1 are distinct parallel left/down oblique rays rooted at O and O_1 respectively.
Each origin is the junction of its own three coordinate rays.
The upper velocity arrow is rooted on Y_1; its vector-v label is above the arrow.
The lower vector-v_1 arrow is detached, above X/X_1 and to the right of Y_1.
Both velocity arrows point right, parallel to positive X/X_1.
All numeral-one suffixes are subscripts. Both velocity labels carry a rightward vector accent.
K and K_1 are frame labels adjacent to their respective vertical axes, not additional points or vectors.
raw_print_observations: Small dark marks at the tail of the detached velocity arrow belong to the coarse printed arrow stroke; there is no separate symbol there.
No negative axis rays, moving point, distances, angles, dashed projection lines, legend, time marker or numerical values are visible.
